SoftBank Seeks Over $11 Billion in Junk Bonds for OpenAI

SoftBank is seeking to raise over $11 billion through junk bonds. The funds are intended for its investment in OpenAI. SoftBank is described as one of the world's largest investors in artificial intelligence, with its financial success linked to its ability to profit from its OpenAI stake.
